The highest titer in Table 2 is **(−)-α-bisabolol at 102,300 mg L⁻¹ (102.3 g L⁻¹)**, produced by the **HBQA7 → SMB19** strain (reference [22]). The table lists the cultivation mode as **fed-batch** with a fermentation time of **110 h**, and the strategy as "genome integration of the biosynthetic pathway and optimization of precursor supply" (Table 2, page 9).

Page 11 adds that full chromosomal integration of the pathway produced an antibiotic-free strain reaching this record titer in a **50-L bioreactor**.

The next-highest entries in Table 2 are (2R,3R)-2,3-butanediol from MG1→ΔslaC-bdhA at 89,810 mg L⁻¹ and acetoin from H32-nox at 75,200 mg L⁻¹ (both on page 9).
